props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective distance in px. Lower = more dramatic.

props.name: glare
props.description: Show the specular glare that follows the pointer.

props.name: depthScale
props.description: Scale multiplier applied to all TiltLayer z offsets.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer perspective wrapper. className styles the card itself.

props.name: z
props.description: translateZ in px (scaled by the card's depthScale).
